name: Iino Katsumi
source:
A boy who Riichi met in a park. Although he's typically an easygoing university student, he's "three faced". Iino's secrets are revealed in the process of getting to know each other normally.

Riichi's preferred college senior. He's a little out of shape, but he's about to graduate from college and seems to be having a lot of troubles.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080611152858/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/natuiro_cyara_iino.html]official website[/url]]
